signatureAbility.signatureActivationDescription: Make consecutive passes for 5+ yards in air
signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Many passers use a combination of mobility and aggressiveness to make big plays. When they enter the zone, they have perfect accuracy while throwing on the run.
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws inside the numbers (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws outside the numbers (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on any high point throws under 20 yards.
Passers with this ability receive better blocking support on designed quarterback run plays.
Passers with this ability improve the catching prowess of all running backs who are open on pass plays.
Zone Hawk defenders lock down a part of the field. When they enter the zone, this ability increases the rate of interceptions while in zone coverage.
Defenders with this ability have higher chance to catch uncontested interceptions, and they have unlimited stamina on the return (until using a special move or breaking a tackle).
Defenders with this ability can make jumping, 180-degree interceptions while lurking in a zone in the middle of the field.
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in any mid-field zone coverage, less than 20 yards from the LoS inside the numbers and 10-20 outside.
Some pass rushers intimidate quarterbacks with their sheer presence. When they enter the zone, they can apply significant pressure on quarterbacks even while engaged with blockers.
Defenders with this ability use faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks against inside run plays.
Defenders with this ability do not need to spend a point on shed attempts during a run play
Defenders with this ability can reach out of engaged blocks to tackle or sack nearby ballcarriers.
The best physical receivers don't just come down with the ball, they carry it home. When they enter the zone, they are nearly guaranteed to break their first post-catch tackle.
When lined up at tight end, players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments.
Ballcarriers with this ability will frequently attempt to gain extra yards while being tackled
After securing a RAC catch, ballcarriers with this ability can quickly shift momentum, change direction, and turn the corner without sacrificing speed.
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in any mid-field zone coverage, less than 20 yards from the LoS inside the numbers and 10-20 outside.
Defenders with this ability have higher chance to catch uncontested interceptions, and they have unlimited stamina on the return (until using a special move or breaking a tackle).
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 20+ yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke and spin animations.
Players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes, regardless of where they line up.
Aggressive receivers overpower defenders and attack the football. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their success rate on aggressive catches against single coverage.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, outside the numbers
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable spin animations.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke animations.
Blockers with this ability have an increased number of blocker resistance points
Blockers with this ability reduce an edge pass rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move
During preplay, players with this ability will highlight any oncoming blitzers on 3rd and 4th downs. Can be bluffed.
Blockers with this ability defend against swim/club pass rush moves as if they had an additional resistance point
